notifications.title: The Kalinov Bridge holds
notifications.body: The last horde broke against the walls and the rite was finished. The bridge over the Smorodina is sealed, Nav is shut, and the bells of the Holy City ring for the first time in a generation. The old faith lives on, because you held.

notifications.title: The Holy City held
notifications.body: The horde was beaten at its walls after 12 rounds.

notifications.title: A horde is at the Holy City
notifications.body: 36 of them against its guard of 45.

notifications.title: Brother Siegfried grows stronger

notifications.title: You's refuge was raided
notifications.body: The horde carried off 435 resources after 1 rounds.

notifications.title: Ritual Night
notifications.body: With the arch sealed, the volkhvs begin the rite that will close the crossing for good. Every horde in Nav feels it. Tonight they all come at once, from every front, to break the city before the last words are spoken.

notifications.title: The Ritual Arch stands
notifications.body: The Kalinov Bridge is whole. Ritual Night is coming.

notifications.title: Raising The Ritual Arch
notifications.body: Everything it needs is in place; the builders are at work.
